finding.repair: Author captures full new-task idea_state/status/latest-transition immediately after normal admission and compares it again after request/context writes, before commit. Postcommit current state may advance legitimately; legacy exact-task replay does not invent a creation-history requirement.
finding.bounded_projection: The final status/latest-state/sop SELECT size projection was separately approved hardening, not a reproduced defect or a fifth red variant.
